name: ikechukwu11/nativephp-custom-ota
description: Self-hosted, Bifrost-independent over-the-air (OTA) PHP payload updates for NativePHP Mobile

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Check
bridge_functions.description: Check an HTTPS manifest.json or custom API endpoint for a newer signed OTA release

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Download
bridge_functions.description: Download an OTA zip, verify size, SHA-256, and Ed25519 signature, and stage to updates/pending.zip

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Apply
bridge_functions.description: Queue the staged pending zip for NativePHP core to extract on the next boot

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Rollback
bridge_functions.description: Restore the previous pending zip as updates/pending.zip for next-boot apply

bridge_functions.name: Ota.GetStatus
bridge_functions.description: Return current version, pending status, and rollback availability

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Prompt
bridge_functions.description: Check in the background and, when a release is waiting, prompt Later / Update
